targetTest: returns at most 200 hits and records truncated: true when more exist
expected: git-files over 250 matching files returns 200 handles and sets stats.truncated to true
actual: stats.truncated stays false (false !== true): the adapter cuts at 200 hits but never says so; the assembler reads 40 snippets where 30 are allowed, does not cut a 10 MiB excerpt, pages a paged source once and never aborts a slow source
semanticAssessment: Ten of the 30 tests ran to their planned assertions and failed on the missing cap behavior (hit truncation flag, unscoped refusal, cancellation, timeout abort, snippet cap, returned-byte cap, page cap, entry cap, query timeout). They ran against real scratch repositories and a real onboarded project through the production composition, with fakes only for sources that must misbehave. The 20 that pass assert behavior task 1 built (the guard, the counters, the race over six processes, the cap table and its parser). No import, syntax or fixture fault: findWithin is a skeleton that asks the source with no timeout.
